lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-contrast circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular 2D grid posterior to the gill slits; local maxima are organized in at least four parallel horizontal trajectories along the lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical segments of elevated pixel intensity intersect the longitudinal ridges and horizontal spot rows, creating a grid-like topology where high-luminance blobs serve as anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal carinae exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient (highlighted superior edge, shadowed inferior edge) extending longitudinally across the upper lateral flank.
